notes.title: EMPTY SHELL 2 DEMO OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

A bit out of the blue, I'm thrilled to announce that [b]the demo for EMPTY SHELL 2 is now available on Steam[/b]!
Which also means that [b]the second chapter of EMPTY SHELL is well into development[/b]!

The game is a [b]direct sequel[/b] to the first chapter, and it comes with some major new features. Let me briefly tell you about the two most noticeable ones:

[list]
[*]As you can see from the trailer and screenshots, the K-Link satellite system used to monitor volunteers has received a major upgrade and [b]can now transmit color images[/b].
Not exactly the most colorful broadcast ever seen, I’ll admit. :)
[b]But for those of you who are fond of black and white, there’s an option to use the original K-Link view as well[/b].

[*] The second major change is the [b]gameplay loop[/b]: while progression in the first EMPTY SHELL was more traditional and linear, level after level, [b]in EMPTY SHELL 2, volunteers will be housed together in a building on the island, which they can return to even in the middle of a mission or with partially completed objectives[/b] (provided they find an extraction zone… and make it there alive).
They’ll bring back gear and resources to stash in the shelter, to be used later either by themselves or by future volunteers who will replace them in case of… unfortunate outcomes.
[/list]

Speaking of objectives, there will now also be [b]optional secondary objectives[/b] that can be completed at your discretion to top up the base pay promised at contract signing.

Alright, volunteers, I’ll leave the rest for you to discover: try the demo and let me know what you think!
As always, I’ll be here reading all your feedback and working hard in the coming weeks and beyond to fix everything I’m sure you’ll find that’s not working properly, unbalanced, or just off in any way.
[h3]One last VERY IMPORTANT thing: if you enjoy the demo of EMPTY SHELL 2, please remember to add the game to your wishlist and leave a review for the demo.
That’s the only way the game can gain enough visibility to keep development going.[/h3]

That said, load a couple shells into that old hunting shotgun and sharpen your trusty hatchet:
It’s time to go back into the Facility.

notes.title: Recoverable stuff + pixelation
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

I've been reading some reviews lately and more than one player was pointing to how harsh is the loot recovered from the dead volunteer after you die.

So, today's update brings some changes to the [b]amount/type of items you'll find while looting the dead body[/b]. Specifically:

[b]EASY[/b]
[list]
[*]higher probability to recover weapons/gadgets/consumables/ammo (20% more each)
[*]can recover more than one ranged weapon/gadget
[*]higher amount of cash recovered (30-35% more)
[*]can recover up to 10 upgraded stats (was 3)
[/list]
[b]MEDIUM[/b]
[list]
[*]higher probability to recover weapons/gadgets/consumables/ammo (10% more each)
[*]can recover more than one ranged weapon/gadget
[*]higher amount of cash recovered (10-20% more)
[*]can recover up to 6 upgraded stats (was 3)
[/list]
[b]HARD[/b]
[list]
[*]higher probability to recover stuweapons/gadgets/consumables/ammoff (5% more each)
[*]higher amount of cash recovered (10% more)
[*]can recover up to 4 upgraded stats (was 3)
[/list]
[b]NIGHTMARE AND MORE[/b]
No changes

Another important update is the new option (long due, i know) to [b]completely disable the pixelation in-game[/b].

I like the game very pixelated, but i understand that not everyone might like it that way :)

notes.title: Safety first
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

A quick update for a couple of gadgets, the [b]rocket launcher turret[/b] and the [b]anti-tank mine[/b]: i've made them a little less dangerous to use. Specifically:

[list]
[*]the rocket launcher turret now has a [b]2 seconds deployment time[/b] before starting to target enemies
[*]the anti-tank mine now has a [b]1 second deployment time[/b] before activating
[/list]

This way, unexpected situations (like blowing up) should decrease significantly :)

notes.title: (Mild) ammo rebalancing
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

This update brings a ammo rebalancing (mild, for now). You are more likely to notice it at higher difficulties, but in general:

- now there are [b]more Small caliber[/b] bullets and [b]slightly less Medium caliber[/b] bullets
- the spawn of [b]Shells[/b] and [b]Large caliber[/b] bullets has been [b]slightly reduced[/b] too
- the [b]prices and the amounts[/b] of bullets in the Upgrade Stations [b]have been adjusted[/b] (less cheap)

Also, [b]MD5A2-B has been buffed[/b], specifically:

- faster reload time (2.2s -> 1.5s)
- damage increased by 4%
- kickback increased by 48% (was too low due to the low rate of fire, compared to automatic weapons)

Misc:
- You will now see [b]how much bullets you're buying[/b] at the Upgrade Stations

notes.title: Technical update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've just updated the Prologue to match some content (QoL updates, bug fixing, balancing and UI/effects options) of the full version.
This is just a technical update to prioritize the loading of the save files from the Prologue, rather than the Next Fest demo, that was only available in October for one week.

notes.title: COMPENDIUM + Iron Volunteer
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

With today's update, the [b]COMPENDIUM[/b] will be available in the main menu. It contains unlockable entries of the creatures that inhabit the Facility, with 3d models and extra informations.

Also, [b]Iron Volunteer[/b], a new game mode, is available upon beating New Game+. While similar to the latter, in this mode enemies will inflict [b]very high damage, but so do you[/b]. It is indeed a faster approach to the gameplay, with [b]little to no room for mistakes[/b]. Plus, [b]Devices will cost 50% less[/b], so it's a chance to try the ones you still miss.
Ah, you only have [b]one Volunteer[/b], then it's game over...

I didn't add a new achievement for beating Iron Volunteer, but you'll be rewarded with something else: [b]a crown icon will appear next to your name in the Leaderboard[/b], to prove that you have completed the ultimate challenge in the Facility.

Other minor changes:
[list]
[*]difficulty is now shown in the final stats at the end of the game
[*]Semi-heavy and Heavy Laser Rifles now deal quite more damage
[/list]

notes.title: Stats fixes
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

A couple of stats bug fixes, today:

[list]
[*][b]Kills, Deaths and Rounds Fired[/b] counters in the leaderboard were resetting after a "New game", now [b]they keep updating[/b]
[*][b]Equipment Found Bonus[/b] stat was increasing after opening the same box multiple times, now fixed to increase [b]only once per box[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Some improvements
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Here's the changelog for this update:

[list]
[*]Now [b]Upgrade Stations[/b] show the [b]type of ammo[/b] used by ranged weapons
[*][b]Beta[/b] and [b]Gamma Emitter[/b] Devices inflict [b]way more damage[/b] than before (and last a little longer)
[*]Devices prices has been tweaked (the mid-late game ones are [b]a little cheaper[/b])
[*]Fixed a problem with the [b]Found Documents[/b] that was preventing to get the [b]TRUTH[/b] achievement if you played the Prologue or the Next Fest Demo before
[*]Fixed a bug that was [b]misaligning some elements of the UI[/b] when changing the resolution from the pause menu
[/list]

notes.title: Technical update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone.

Just fixed a problem that could happen very rarely. Some player, after a crash on startup (even a power failure) had a config file corrupted that was preventing the game to boot properly.
Now it's fixed.
Also, one document (79) [b]seemed to spawn too infrequently[/b]. This is fixed as well.

notes.title: Small ammo drop + small QoL
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Another small update, today:

[list]
[*]Now Armed Soulless (except for the ones with Rocket Launcher) [b]drop a (very) few ammo on death[/b] (the amount scales with difficulty)
[*]I've removed the "floating" effect from the [b]Found documents screen[/b], to improve readability
[/list]

When close enough, the dropped ammo is automatically collected if you already own the same type of ammo or a compatible weapon (and have enough space in the inventory).
Otherwise is dropped in the form of a lootable package.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Just a couple of minor things:

[list]
[*] I've added an [b]index[/b] id to the "[b]found documents[/b]". Could be useful for reference.
[*] The price of the [b]Rocket Launcher Turret[/b] is now [b]850[/b] (it was 800) and the [b]ammo is now 3[/b] (it was 5): it was too overpowered after the Rockets/Grenades update
[/list]

notes.title: Terminate volunteer + minor fixed
notes.content:
Hey!

From now on you'll find the "[b]Terminate volunteer[/b]" button in the pause screen: this way, if needed, you can [b]quickly end a session[/b] and start with a new volunteer (from the same level).

Also:
[list]
[*]now the distance of the previously dead volunteer body scales with difficulty: closer on Easy, slightly closer on Medium and Hard (didn't change on NIGHTMARE/NG+)
[*]fixed a couple of metal containers that weren't shielding properly from the rotating laser in the second level
[/list]

notes.title: Shotguns Overhaul + The Barge + Accuracy
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

This update will bring some changes to the s[b]hotguns[/b] in the game. Specifically:
[list]
[*][b]Pump action shotgun[/b]: 30% more damage, ~11% less damage decay (distance), 20% less spread
[*][b]Revolver shotgun[/b]: 10% more damage, 12% less damage decay (distance)
[*][b]Double-barreled shotgun[/b]: 20% more damage, 12% less damage decay (distance)
[/list]

Also, shotgun pellets (for every type of shotgun) has now a [b]35% probability to pass through enemies[/b] and damage other enemies in the line of fire.

Beyond shotguns:
[list]
[*]now you can find the [b]previously dead volunteer body in The Barge level[/b] too.
[*]fixed the final [b]accuracy stat[/b] (now should be correct)
[/list]

notes.title: UI, Rocket Launcher and Grenade Launcher
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!
Here's a few things that comes with this update:

[list]
[*]When UI Effects is turned off, the [b]flickering effect[/b] too now is completely turned off in the in-game views (inventory, lore items, puzzles, upgrades, etc)
[*][b]Rocket launchers is now way more devastating[/b] (~80% more), but rockets are more scarce
[*][b]Same for the Grenade Launcher[/b], less powerful than a Rocket Launcher, but less expensive and with more ammo to be found
[*]Added the "drop inventory item" button in the keybindings screen
[/list]

notes.title: Tiny fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with a boss
Fixed a bug with final stats

notes.title: Recoverable Stats
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Thanks for all the feedback as usual. This update brings [b]upgraded stats as recoverable items[/b] from the volunteer dead body.
This should create a better feeling of progression and makes difficulty, while still challenging, less harsh.
You'll be able to recover [b]up to 3[/b] of your previously upgraded stats (if you had less, you'll find all of them).
I've changed/fixed a few other things, this is the full change log:

[list]
[*] Upgraded stats recoverable from dead volunteer body
[*] Critical chance stat now gives a 3% boost, while slightly less common to find (was 1%)
[*] The bug that sometimes was causing the doors in the reactor room of the Aerospace Center to stay closed should be fixed
[*] A new Upgrade Station in The Woods (now there are 2, previously was 1)
[*] You'll always find at least one medikit and some ammo in the Upgrade Stations
[*] Looping sfx while leaving a stationary turret or depleting a machine gun drone is fixed
[/list]

[b]Let me know of the new update feels![/b]

notes.title: Update: respawn after death and fairness
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

In this update i've tried to make less painfull (while still challenging) [b]respawning after death[/b].

While with the previous update i've increased the probability to recover equipment from the previous volunteer body, this time i've changed the spawn location of the body: they were spawning in the same room they died, but this means that, due to the layout diversification each time, could have been at the opposite side of the level (or straight in a boss room), that actually jeopardize the very purpose of recovering equipment.

Now you still have to explore and find the body, but it will be more [b]closer to the initial rooms[/b], rather than in some remote location.

[b]Obviously, I'm trying to keep the game very challenging... just more fair :)[/b]

Other than that, these are the other changes:

[list]
[*] The probability of finding equipment now scales with the difficulty level (higher on easy, lower on NIGHTMARE)
[*] Easy difficulty is now a little easier (less damage taken, more damage given)
[*] Nailguns are more powerful
[*] Devices prices have been tweaked (a little less expensive)
[/list]

Let me know how it goes!

notes.title: UI Size - new update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone,

I've reverted the previous arbitrary update on the UI Size and added a [b]proper option[/b] to chose between "[b]original[/b]", "[b]medium[/b]" and "[b]big[/b]".
This is valid for the menus and all the "overviews", like inventory, map, upgrades, lore items, puzzles etc.
Let me know how it goes!

notes.title: Readability quick update
notes.content:
Hey!

Just did a quick update on the UI, [b]especially in parts with lot of text[/b] (like story view, lore items view, inventory, upgrades, etc).
In general:

[list]
[*] bigger text
[*] less distortion
[/list]
It's not perfect yet, but it should be an improvement already.
Feel free to let me know what you think!

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.content:
Hey! Just a few things, for now:

[list]
[*] The fixed machine gun turrets caliber has been corrected. The Cal. 50 was a little misleading, cause they're good but not THAT powerful. It's now 7.62x54r, makes more sense.
[*] And always the fixed machine gun turrets do a little more damage, now
[*] The Zombie Big Soulless (the enemy that charges you) is now less bullet spongy
[*] Fixed some levels colliders here and there
[/list]

notes.title: EMPTY SHELL available now
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Has been a long journey since the release of the Prologue, in January, but finally [b]the full version of EMPTY SHELL is available[/b].

The ship carrying the volunteers has set sail. They will be sent to the Facility, abandoned for more than two decades, which awaits them shrouded in [b]the mystery of the 1950s accident[/b] and populated with [b]whatever is lurking down there[/b].

I'll be all ears for any feedback/bug/suggestion as always; i did my best to give [b]EMPTY SHELL[/b] the best shape, but i'm sure it can get even better! If you enjoy the game, would be great if you review it on Steam as soon as you can, that'd be very helpful!

Thanks for your application, volunteer.
And good luck.
You'll need it.

notes.title: Steam NEXT Fest is here- check out the brand new EMPTY SHELL demo!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

[b]EMPTY SHELL[/b] celebrates [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], starting [b]October 9[/b].
To anticipate the [b]full release of the game on October 16, 10am PST[/b], a [b]brand new Demo[/b] will be playable for the duration of the event. This will allow you to prepare properly for the full game, [b]available right after the Next Fest ends[/b]. You will be then able to jump right into the full experience with a head start, as the Demo progress carries over to the full version.

[previewyoutube=PGemqdsdTpw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you played previous pre-release versions of EMPTY SHELL, you might be wondering what's new in the Steam NEXT Fest demo. Here are the highlights:
[list]
[*] New [b]reloading system[/b]: weapons now have proper mags, so you'll need to keep an eye on the bullets counter, if you want to avoid getting caught reloading in the middle of a fight
[*] [b]Secret rooms[/b]: every level will have one or more secret rooms, hidden behind walls, where you might find interesting loot. The [b]DETECTOR[/b] is a new gadget that will help you find these rooms
[*] [b]Two new achievements[/b]
[*] An [b]interacting console[/b] that can be used to discover more lore about the Facility and the experiments that took place there
[*] The [b]Worm[/b] has a new design and a better behavior: still tough, but more manageable
[*] The [b]Shotgun[/b] has been re-balanced, with fair stopping power and a better distribution of the damage based on distance
[*] The [b]Laser Rifle[/b] has now a fairer charging time, that should make it more convenient to use
[/list]

Again, [b]any progress you make in the demo will carry over the full game[/b]: you'll be able to pick up where you left or start fresh, you choose. 

[i]Enjoying EMPTY SHELL? Make sure to add the full game to your Steam wishlist - this is the most welcome and effective way of supporting us, aside from purchasing the game day one, and reviewing it as soon as you know you love it![/i]

Ready to set foot in the derelict facility? 
[h3]See you at the Next Fest, volunteers![/h3]
